title: Red Team Operator
summary: A red team operator imitates how a real attacker would break into a company over a longer, stealthy engagement, then shows the defenders what worked. They sit in a security team or consultancy and go deeper on evasion and adversary emulation than a penetration tester, who runs shorter, broader tests.
dailyDuties: Plan full-scope adversary emulation engagements against agreed goals
Set up and operate command-and-control (C2) infrastructure
Attack Active Directory identity and privilege paths
Write custom tooling and automation for engagements
Map actions to MITRE ATT&CK and test detection coverage
Work with the blue team to improve defences
Write clear reports and brief stakeholders on findings
